# Google Marketing Platform
> Enterprise advertising and analytics platform that unifies media buying, measurement, tagging, and customer insights.

Google Marketing Platform brings together Google’s enterprise advertising and analytics products, including campaign management, display and video buying, search advertising, analytics, and tag management.

## Platform Overview
- [Home](https://marketingplatform.google.com/about/): Overview of Google Marketing Platform and its integrated advertising and analytics solutions.
- [For Small Businesses](https://marketingplatform.google.com/about/small-business/): Introduces solutions tailored for smaller teams and growing businesses.
- [For Enterprises](https://marketingplatform.google.com/about/enterprise/): Explains enterprise-focused products, workflows, and platform capabilities.
- [Resources](https://marketingplatform.google.com/about/resources/): Central hub for educational content, insights, and customer stories.

## Advertising Products
- [Campaign Manager 360](https://marketingplatform.google.com/about/campaign-manager-360/): Ad management and measurement platform for campaigns across channels.
- [Display & Video 360](https://marketingplatform.google.com/about/display-video-360/): Programmatic display, video, TV, and audio campaign planning and buying.
- [Search Ads 360](https://marketingplatform.google.com/about/search-ads-360/): Search campaign management and optimization across major search engines.
- [Enterprise Solutions](https://marketingplatform.google.com/about/enterprise/): Overview of integrated advertising tools for large organizations.

## Analytics and Measurement
- [Analytics](https://marketingplatform.google.com/about/analytics/): Web and app analytics for understanding users, traffic, and conversions.
- [Analytics 360](https://marketingplatform.google.com/about/analytics-360/): Enterprise analytics with advanced support, integrations, and governance features.
- [Campaign Manager 360](https://marketingplatform.google.com/about/campaign-manager-360/): Includes ad serving, attribution, and campaign measurement capabilities.
- [Resources](https://marketingplatform.google.com/about/resources/): Access measurement-focused guides, reports, and educational materials.

## Tagging and Data Collection
- [Tag Manager](https://marketingplatform.google.com/about/tag-manager/): Manage website and app tags without editing site code directly.
- [Tag Manager 360](https://marketingplatform.google.com/about/tag-manager-360/): Enterprise tag management with collaboration and governance capabilities.
- [Analytics](https://marketingplatform.google.com/about/analytics/): Connect collected event and audience data to reporting workflows.
- [Analytics 360](https://marketingplatform.google.com/about/analytics-360/): Enterprise analytics destination for governed data collection and analysis.

## Resources and Learning
- [Resources](https://marketingplatform.google.com/about/resources/): Main resource center for product education and marketing best practices.
- [Success Stories](https://marketingplatform.google.com/about/resources/success-stories/): Customer case studies showing business outcomes with the platform.
- [Insights](https://marketingplatform.google.com/about/resources/insights/): Research, trends, and thought leadership for marketers and analysts.
- [Community](https://marketingplatform.google.com/about/resources/community/): Community programs and learning opportunities for platform users.

## Audience-Specific Paths
- [For Small Businesses](https://marketingplatform.google.com/about/small-business/): Recommended product path for smaller organizations and lean marketing teams.
- [For Enterprises](https://marketingplatform.google.com/about/enterprise/): Recommended product path for complex organizations with advanced advertising needs.
- [Analytics](https://marketingplatform.google.com/about/analytics/): Entry point for teams focused on measurement and customer insights.
- [Tag Manager](https://marketingplatform.google.com/about/tag-manager/): Entry point for teams implementing and maintaining marketing tags.

## Customer Stories and Insights
- [Success Stories](https://marketingplatform.google.com/about/resources/success-stories/): Real-world examples of brands using the platform to improve results.
- [Insights](https://marketingplatform.google.com/about/resources/insights/): Articles and research on advertising, analytics, and measurement strategy.
- [Blog](https://blog.google/products/marketingplatform/360/): Official Google Marketing Platform blog with product updates and announcements.
- [Community](https://marketingplatform.google.com/about/resources/community/): Community content, events, and peer learning opportunities.

## Product Discovery
- [Campaign Manager 360](https://marketingplatform.google.com/about/campaign-manager-360/): Learn about ad serving, trafficking, reporting, and attribution workflows.
- [Display & Video 360](https://marketingplatform.google.com/about/display-video-360/): Learn about audience planning, inventory buying, and cross-channel activation.
- [Search Ads 360](https://marketingplatform.google.com/about/search-ads-360/): Learn about search automation, reporting, and campaign optimization.
- [Analytics 360](https://marketingplatform.google.com/about/analytics-360/): Learn about enterprise-grade analytics and deeper customer insight capabilities.
- [Tag Manager 360](https://marketingplatform.google.com/about/tag-manager-360/): Learn about scalable tag deployment and governance for large teams.
